---
title: Section wrapper ids, revealjs
format: revealjs
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'section#sec-s2.slide.bg'
          - 'section#sec-x.slide'
          - 'a.quarto-xref[href="#/sec-s2"]'
          - 'div#frag.fragment'
        - - 'section#myslide'
          - 'section#explicit'
---

Revealjs strips slide heading ids, so a crossref to a heading wrapped in an
id'd Div must resolve to the slide through the heading id moved onto the
section. This covers a plain wrapper, an explicit `.section` wrapper (also
swapped in revealjs), and a `.fragment` wrapper, which is never merged.
